title: IAF AgentOS SKILL.md frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter block at the top of every SKILL.md. Mirrors the fields read by IAF-Agent-Skills/iaf_agent_skills/loader.py.

name.description: Skill identifier. Lower-case snake_case; must match the parent folder name.

version.description: Semantic-ish version string. Bump on breaking changes to triggers, tools, or contract.

description.description: Single-paragraph summary of what the skill does. Used by routers and the orchestrator manager LLM to decide when to invoke.

execution_mode.description: How the skill runs. 'react' = LLM picks tools each turn. 'workflow' = deterministic DAG. 'parallel' = fan-out. 'supervisor' = fixed worker fan-out. 'orchestrator' = manager LLM dynamically calls worker_skills. 'planned' = DAG planner.

react_runtime.description: Implementation runtime for execution_mode=react. 'langgraph' preserves the current LangGraph ReAct loop. 'native' selects the provider-native React runtime when an adapter is configured; otherwise rollback/fallback remains langgraph. This is not an execution_mode.

triggers.description: Phrases the router matches against user queries to suggest this skill.

tools.description: Whitelist of tools the SkillAgent may bind. Final list is further filtered by entitlement policy.

mcp_tools.description: Names of MCP-provided tools to bind for this skill.

mcp_connections.description: MCP connections to mount before the ReAct loop starts.

context_files.description: Reference list of markdown context files, read by the Skill Builder for display. NOTE: the runtime loader injects only the singular 'context_file' into the prompt; use that field for runtime injection.

context_file.description: Single per-skill context markdown (virtual path, e.g. /shared/contexts/x.md). Read by loader.py and auto-injected into the prompt when this skill is active. Empty string means none.

connections.description: Data connections (database/api/erp) bound for this skill. Read by loader.py into Skill.connections.

profile.description: Harness execution profile. Read by loader.py; empty string means the agent/tenant default profile.

knowledge.description: Knowledge entries this skill writes/reads in MEMORY.md. Used by learning hooks.

sql_mode.description: Whether run_sql_query may issue DML/DDL. Defaults to read-only.

max_steps.description: Hard cap on iterations. For orchestrator/planned modes this bounds the manager loop; for react it bounds tool calls.

worker_skills.description: For execution_mode=supervisor/orchestrator. Either a list of skill names (strings) or objects with name + description.

steps.description: For execution_mode=workflow/parallel. Ordered list of steps; the engine executes them deterministically.

business_context.description: Structured business rules and roles the skill enforces.

approval_rules.description: HITL gates. Maps tool/action names to approval requirements (always, threshold, role-based).

evidence_highlights.description: Patterns the evidence viewer should highlight in outputs from this skill.

sufficiency_criteria.description: Conditions that, when met, signal the agent has gathered enough to answer. Used by the ReAct stop-condition.

files.description: Auxiliary files bundled with the skill folder (templates, fixtures).

user_data.description: Per-user data schema this skill reads/writes under enterprise_root/.../users/<user>/.

entitlements.description: Policy hints consumed by the entitlement provider. Actual enforcement lives in enterprise_root/.../security/policies.yaml.
